Appearance

Tall and powerfully built, with black hair in a warrior's knot and a silver-streaked beard. Wears dark iron armor engraved with silver runes and carries a large war hammer.

What We Know

Member of the Nightstalkers adventuring party. Husband to Fiona Hammerfist. A patron at the Sturdy Mugg known for his imposing presence.

First Impressions

A mountain of a man who looks like he could split a table in half with one swing.

Interactions

  • Overheard at breakfast discussing the mines — rushed off to clear them first
  • Body found in the mines — suspended inside a Gelatinous Cube
